title: Hell at Val Verde
overview: With the great alchemist slain and the dissection of the world stopped, it's time for Hibiki to face her greatest enemy yet: summer homework!

title: Last Resort
overview: The Bavarian Illuminati has struck at SONG in a small South American country. It's up to the Symphogear wielders to fight them off and gain time for the non-combatants to escape.

title: A Horoscope Drawn by Gears
overview: The Bavarian Illuminati has followed SONG to Japan, and has a powerful new kind of Alca-Noise that they're using to trap the Symphogear wielders. Can they escape?

title: Golden Transmutation
overview: SONG brings the Val Verde documents to a secret base dating from World War 2, but the Illuminati tracks them there as well.

title: Risking Your Life in a Fictional Warzone
overview: Adam, the controlling director of the Illuminati, has used a powerful alchemic spell to destroy the Kazanari Organization's base. Now it's up to SONG to deal with the fallout.

title: Surfacing From the Suicide Zone
overview: The goal of the Alchemists is revealed as they try to stop the Symphogears from halting their march towards a more perfect world. Their final goal? The lunar ruins.

title: ARCANA No. 00
overview: Shirabe and Kirika engage the Alchemists while the remainder of the team searches for a secret item that will allow them to use their Ignite Modules.

title: In the Gap Between Past and Future
overview: The wielders find the Fool's Stone, and can now use their powerful Ignite modules against their alchemist foes. Cagliostro is the first to challenge them and their new power...

title: Blue Bunny
overview: The group trains so that everyone can pair with any other team member and use their powerful Unison attacks. But Shirabe is having trouble pairing up with anybody but Kirika, because of her inability to trust others.

title: An Tiki Thera
overview: With what they've learned from the shrine, the Symphogear wielders now know the full extent of the Illumanti's plan: they're going to use an ancient gate to summon the power of a god. Only one person can stop them: Hibiki, the "God-Slayer".

title: Ultimate Apotheosis
overview: The power of stars descends on Tiki. Despite the best efforts of the Symphogear wielders, and some unexpected help, she completes the ritual and becomes a divine weapon.

title: AXZ
overview: The divine power chooses Hibiki as its vessel. To stop the worldwide disaster she could cause, the U.S. initiates a wide-scale attack on Japan.

title: Every Time Tears Overlap, the Reality Proven Is...
overview: Adam throws aside his pride and beauty and assumes the form of a huge monster. It will take the power of all six Symphogear wielders to bring him down.
